hero.title: MANUFACTURING & AUTOMATION
hero.lead: PLC Programming, Conveyor Automation, Production Monitoring Systems and Engineering Support— at Isuzu Hicom Malaysia.

about.label: ABOUT
about.heading: From Design Drawings to Live Production Lines.
paragraphs: Manufacturing and automation professional with more than four years of automotive manufacturing experience at Isuzu Hicom Malaysia. I work across PLC programming, industrial automation, electrical wiring, machine troubleshooting, CAD design, production monitoring, and line improvement.

Project work spans automated conveyor systems, real-time production dashboards, new model piloting, assembly line modification, facility upgrades, and engineering fabrication — from concept drawings through commissioning.

items.title: Production Monitoring System
items.body: Built a real-time production monitoring dashboard from scratch with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — giving supervisors Plan vs Actual output, cycle time, machine status, and accumulated downtime in one interactive view. Replaced manual tracking and continues to be refined for data accuracy across live sources.

blocks.title: Problem statement
items: Manual data collection in production line resulted in delay reporting, human error and difficulty in monitoring target in real life

blocks.title: Objectives
items: To develop real time production monitoring system to improve production visibility of production performance

items.title: Paintshop Conveyor Sealant Line
items.body: Completed Mitsubishi Electric PLC Q Series and GOT2000 training, then developed ladder logic for motor control, sensor detection, timing sequences, and machine interlocks. Supported hardware selection, electrical wiring, control panel assembly, sensor installation, testing, and commissioning through handover.

blocks.title: Problem statement
items: Manual practice - need 2 manpower to push skid due to its weight. Increase risk of injury due to repetitive and wrong posture

blocks.title: Objectives
items: To develop automatic operation of sealant line conveyor and reduce eliminate manpower to push skid

items.title: Local Parts Receiving Area Structure
items.body: Led planning for a RM60,000 structural awning installation — specifications, quantity estimation, SolidWorks 2D/3D layouts for vendors, scheduling coordination, and on-site measurement verification to match design intent and operational needs.

blocks.title: Problem statement
items: Unloading parts takes times during heavy rain forcing the forklift driver to wait. Heavy rain also can cause accident due to poor visiParts also can become rusty due to exposure to water and

blocks.title: Objectives
items: Design structure using SolidWorks for an efficient and safe receiving area and to improve flow and accessibility during unloading parts.

items.title: Bodyshop Assembly Line & Jig Modification
items.body: Managed drawing modifications from Isuzu Motors Japan (IML) for a new assembly line layout separating Basic Model and Crew Cab production. Supported jig positioning, gantry modification planning, site measurements, and drawing verification before implementation.

blocks.title: Problem statement
items: The existing Body Shop assembly-line layout needed to be improved and relocate for new model. Accurate site measurements and a new AutoCAD layout were required for the proposed line modification.

blocks.title: Objectives
items: To measure the existing assembly area and develop an improved line layout using AutoCAD to support the planned Body Shop assembly-line modification.

items.title: New Model Piloting
items.body: Supported trial builds, tooling readiness checks, cross-department fitment resolution, and production documentation for new vehicle introduction.

items.title: FTS Vehicle & Rotary Switch
items.body: Managed FTS military vehicle documentation, rotary switch modification studies, wiring changes, and production / after-sales troubleshooting.

items.title: Rear Cargo Fabrication
items.body: Led concept-to-drawing planning for light-duty Isuzu rear cargo — base, support, reinforcement, and fixing parts with material selection and drawing schedules.

items.title: A.G.V. Concept Design
items.body: Converted engineer sketches into detailed 3D and dimensioned drawings for early AGV concept ideas, including schedule planning with engineering.

items.title: Engine & Axle Cart
items.body: Prototype cart design with production teams — site measurements of existing carts, modification confirmation, and 3D detail drawings for reference.

items.title: PTO Wiring Modification
items.body: Studied and executed Power Take-Off wiring modification, installation method, and procedures to meet customer-requested PTO function.
